cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the party log, fill in arrival, kitchen visit and departure. I'll check the times with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You only care who took the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There are three empty boxes. Begin at the top, please; I'll read them back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Put eight for arrival, and put me down for the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eight goes in the first box. 'Me' isn't a time. Let's complete the kitchen box before we add comments.

reason: Let B offer the suspected key admission while A maintains a neutral-looking chronology, using exact data-entry correction rather than revealing which answer matters.
